messages:
sre-oncall: seeing a weird gap in central logs for eu-west1 GPU autoscale window (2176543000-2176543200). Grafana shows node_gpu_util spike and a barrage of 5xx from inference-gateway but Kibana searches for req-hop/tracing entries return nothing for those request IDs. anyone else?

andrew: :eyes: which IDs are you looking at? sample trace id or reqid would help.

sre-oncall: sample trace_id=trc-8f3a2b and req_id=req-ef15. Kibana query I ran: `req_id:"req-ef15" OR trace_id:"trc-8f3a2b"` returns 0. But raw pod logs on the node show the 5xx.

maria: run a Loki query too, sometimes Kibana ingest misses the hop lines. try: ```{job="kubernetes" namespace="inference"} | json | trace_id="trc-8f3a2b"```

kevin: I ran that and got nothing as well. loki-ingester logs show occasional backpressure spikes around 02:04 UTC. Could be sampling or tenant filter dropping hop messages.

loki-bot: alert triggered: loki_ingester_write_backpressure_high (eu-west1) at 2026-03-15T02:06:12Z. Recent pipeline version: v2.4.1.

deploy-bot: rollout: loki-pipeline v2.4.1 -> eu-west1 rolled at 2026-03-15T02:03:47Z (canary -> full).

andrew: ok that timing aligns. v2.4.1 added header-based tenant sampling (opt-in) — maybe rule too broad. have we audited pipeline rules? /etc/loki/pipeline.yaml on canaries showed `drop_if: "headers.x-hop == \"false\""` which might match missing hop header from proxy.

maria: I can ssh into a affected inference node and pull journal and kube-proxy logs. grabbing `journalctl -u inference-gateway -S "2026-03-15 02:00:00" -U "2026-03-15 02:10:00" | grep req-ef15` now.

kevin: also check prom counter `loki_ingester_dropped_entries_total{reason="tenant_filter"}` in Grafana for eu-west1 - looks like a jump at that time.

sre-oncall: quick grep from node shows gateway emitted lines with trace_id trc-8f3a2b but header `x-hop` is absent when the proxy retried the request under heavy load. so pipeline drop rule would remove those.

andrew: can we rollback pipeline or relax rule? rollback window might be noisy. alternative: add fallback where if level=="error" or status>=500, keep event regardless of header.

deploy-bot: rollback candidate: loki-pipeline v2.4.0 available. initiate rollback? :warning: requires passing canary checks.

maria: I'm seeing `loki_ingester_dropped_entries_total` increments of ~1200 at 02:04:00-02:07:00. tenant_filter is the top reason. dashboard: /d/ops/loki-ingest?refresh=5m&var-region=eu-west1

kevin: proposed quick fix: patch pipeline with `keep_if: status >= 500 OR level == "error" OR contains(trace_id)` then restart pipeline workers on canary first. I can open a PR and patch.

andrew: agree. PR + canary patch then watch `loki_ingester_backpressure` and `dropped_entries_total`. If stable after 10m, promote.

sre-oncall: taking action item: create alert cleanup to surface when hop headers are missing on high-error bursts. current alert only highlights ingest backpressure which hid root cause.

maria: grabbing logs and will attach snippets here. partial log line: `2026-03-15T02:04:12Z inference-gateway ERROR trace_id=trc-8f3a2b req_id=req-ef15 status=502 msg="upstream timeout"` (no x-hop).

andrew: nice find. kewl to note: GPU autoscale caused proxy retries that strip x-hop header in the retry path. we should also patch proxy to preserve x-hop on retry. adding to infra backlog.

kevin: PR opened: infra#462 - loki pipeline keep-on-error rule. canary patch applied to eu-west1 at 02:28 UTC. monitoring now.

loki-bot: metric update: loki_ingester_dropped_entries_total decreased to baseline within 4 minutes of canary patch.

sre-oncall: can confirm Kibana now returns the hop lines for req-ef15. closing hunt for now. follow-ups: proxy retry header preservation, add unit test for pipeline sampling, and make ingest alerts surface root causes. :white_check_mark:

andrew: great work team. filing follow-up tickets and notes for postmortem. :thumbsup:

kevin: copying snippets to incident-runbook for easier diagnosis next time.``
